text: Indirect (representative) realism is charged with erecting a ___ of perception: if we are only ever directly aware of inner representations, we can never verify that they correspond to an external world.
explanation: Indirect realism is charged with erecting a 'veil of perception': if we are only ever directly aware of inner representations, we can never confirm that they correspond to any external world, which threatens skepticism. The expected word is 'veil'.
